column1: # The NVIDIA SDK archives this tree builds against, one row per artifact. Each
# row pins the vendor's own release digest, so an installed prefix is verified
# against what the vendor published rather than against what a download
# happened to produce. Installation goes through the PKGBUILDs under the
# workstation's PKGBUILD monorepo (local/cvcuda-bin, local/nvimgcodec-bin),
# which carry the same digests; fetch-nvidia-sdk.sh retrieves an archive into a
# directory and verifies it, and verify-nvidia-sdk.sh reads the installed
# prefix, the package manager's record, and the archive's own version header.
# id             a name the tree refers to
# vendor         who publishes it
# component      the SDK
# version        the vendor's version string, as spelled in the artifact name
# cuda_major     the CUDA major the archive was built against
# arch           target architecture
# artifact_name  the archive file name
# source_url     where the archive is fetched from, without credentials
# sha256         the vendor-published digest of the archive
# install_prefix where the package installs the archive's tree
# package        the pacman package that installs it
# status         pinned, candidate, or retired
# id
cvcuda-lib
cvcuda-dev
nvimgcodec
